blocked_interpolation: Five contiguous date blocks; three interior blocks scored; each full date excluded from fits
future_extrapolation: Final quarter of observed dates; no future samples used in fits; not interpolation
daily_product: Fit all observed anchor dates after validation; cannot use this in-sample product to claim improvement
date_origin: Fixed and shared between train and prediction within each native epoch
legacy_periodicity_caveat: Original standardized five-feature GP retained; periodicity 365.25 is not literal days after feature standardization
